intro.text: The Veristitalians are an order of Rosharan scholars who try to write unbiased, factual histories, to make sense of the present and prepare for the future.

description.text: Unusually for historians, they treat folktales and superstitions as places where scraps of real history can survive.
They hold that most historians care less about truth than about flattering themselves and their motives. Members choose events they feel are misunderstood and try to reconstruct what really happened.
Jasnah counts her fellow members among the finest minds on Roshar and calls them her "sisters", though at least one, Jochi, is a man who writes under a woman's name.
Members keep in touch by spanreed, trading news from around Roshar, following the doings of Heralds, Radiants and Siah Aimians, and working out theories about strange events past and present.

items.text: Jasnah, a Veristitalian, was researching in the Palanaeum when Shallan first met her.
The order was no secret, and Jasnah talked about it openly with Dalinar, Renarin and other people.
